test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held On: 27 June, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
In this question, three statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follows/follow from the statements.

**Statements:**

I. All planets are asteroids.

II. All orbits are asteroids.

III. No star is an asteroid.

**Conclusions:**

I. No planet is a star.

II. No star is an orbit.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

solution:
Given Statements :

All planets are asteroids,

All orbits are asteroids,

No star is an asteroid,

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d1da4087b1b0b2b52b664a176a3ef3e2c3ff42ae95df13524998f626d596e3c5.png] 

Conclusions :

I. No planet is a star - True ( Because, there is no definite relation between planet and star but It is possible so, it's true )

II. No star is an orbit - True ( Because, there is no definite relation between a star and orbit but It is possible so, it's true)

Thus, Both conclusions I and II follow,

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
